title: Liz Truss - Resignation Statement at 10 Downing Street
public_sentiment: Solemn and politically fatal. Delivered after just 44 days in office following market turmoil from her mini-budget. Public and media sentiment viewed the delivery as curt, defiant, and lacking personal contrition or apology.

deductions_strict.explanation: Pitch range was 9.21 st, falling below the 10.56 st corpus baseline floor. Lacks dynamic vocal inflection.
